scientific_integrity: Unnormalized leaf-set counting convolution; all-order proof of the exact two-adic valuation of each Walsh multiplier. Not a Smith-normal-form theorem; no independent assessment.
scientific_limitations: Only labelled unrooted Cayley trees, n>=2, and the prime 2. Source date is a date of supporting literature, not of publication of the present finding. Historical originality assessment is bounded.
title: Leaf-set Walsh recovery and exact dyadic valuations for Cayley trees
